title: API Object Ownership
summary: Build a two-account object-authorization method from HTTP identity through ownership evidence and report limitations.
objectives: Design positive, vulnerable, and negative two-account controls.
Bind ownership observations to reproducible evidence.
Transfer the ownership invariant to an unfamiliar identifier shape.
traditional_lens: Trace identity, object ownership, lookup behavior, policy enforcement, and minimum-impact reproduction.
ai_lens: Use AI to generate and challenge hypotheses without allowing it to invent scope, identities, effects, or proof.
